title: Prove Cursor runs POSIX project hooks on native Windows
text: Decision 15934 keeps the Yoke repository's tracked Cursor and Claude hook files in POSIX form on every host. Claude Code runs hooks through Git Bash on Windows; Cursor on Windows may run hook commands under cmd or PowerShell, where /bin/sh does not resolve, and doctor would then flag hook_command_unstartable for the repository's own hook files. Still owed: the windows-native-lab Cursor check that runs a tracked POSIX project hook from Cursor on native Windows and records whether it starts. Also open for an operator decision: an installed project's tracked hook file is rewritten to the refreshing host's native form, so mixed-OS teams see it switch between forms.
